events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: British comedy icon John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Cleese Comedy
angles.copy: From Python to Fawlty, John Cleese has given us some of the most memorable comedic moments in British history. Happy 87th to a true legend!

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released 58 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Legacy
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles delivered their sprawling, self-titled double album. The 'White Album' – a masterpiece of diverse sounds and a true marker of its time.

events.title: 35 years since the death of Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80.

angles.name: Freddie's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, 35 years on. His voice and showmanship remain unmatched, a true rock god who would have been 80 today.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released 61 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles' sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', was released on December 3, 1965, marking a significant artistic progression for the band.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Milestone
angles.copy: 61 years since The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. An album that truly showcased their evolving sound and songwriting depth.

events.title: 46 years since the death of John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic passing of music icon John Lennon, who would have been 86.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, 46 years after his death. His music and message of peace continue to resonate around the world. He would have been 86 today.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Music legend David Bowie, born in 1947, would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Bowie's Starman Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering David Bowie on what would have been his 80th birthday. A true innovator whose artistic genius continues to inspire.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, born in 1935, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: On what would have been his 92nd birthday, we're celebrating the enduring legacy of Elvis Presley. There's only one King!

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitarist and rock icon Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar God Turns 83
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Jimmy Page! The architect of Led Zeppelin's sound, his riffs are still as electrifying as ever.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: The iconic singer-songwriter Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Rod The Mod Turns 82
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the incomparable Rod Stewart! Still rockin' and croonin' after all these years.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the charismatic frontman of Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Madness Frontman Turns 66
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to Suggs, the voice of Madness! Here's to more 'Our House' moments.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British singer Paul Young, known for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat (That's My Home)', celebrates his 71st birthday today.

angles.name: Young At 71
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday to Paul Young! Still got that soulful voice that defined a generation.

events.title: Dolly Parton would have been 81
events.blurb: Country music legend Dolly Parton, born in 1946, would have celebrated her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Queen of Country
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Dolly Parton on what would have been her 81st birthday. Her music, philanthropy, and spirit continue to shine brightly.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and acclaimed songwriter Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: Barlow At 56
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to Gary Barlow! From Take That anthems to solo hits, his songwriting legacy is undeniable.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean, known for his string of 80s hits, celebrates his 77th birthday today.

angles.name: Caribbean Queen At 77
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday to the one and only Billy Ocean! Still 'Suddenly' making us feel good with those timeless tunes.

events.title: 38 years since the first Rock and Roll Hall Of Fame induction
events.blurb: On January 24, 1989, the first ever induction ceremony for the Rock and Roll Hall Of Fame was held, honouring pioneers like Chuck Berry and Elvis Presley.

angles.name: Hall Of Fame History
angles.copy: 38 years ago today, rock history was made with the very first Rock and Roll Hall Of Fame induction ceremony. Which legends would you put in?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Owen At 55
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to Mark Owen! From boyband heartthrob to solo artist, a consistent presence in UK music.

events.title: 58 years since The Beatles' rooftop concert
events.blurb: On January 30, 1969, The Beatles performed their iconic final live public performance on the rooftop of Apple Corps headquarters in London.

angles.name: Rooftop Revolution
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles made history with their legendary rooftop concert. What a way to go out!

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Grammy-winning artist Phil Collins, known for his work with Genesis and a stellar solo career, celebrates his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: Phil At 76
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to the drumming legend and vocal powerhouse, Phil Collins! An incredible career across decades.

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: Beloved British actor Hugh Grant celebrates his 67th birthday today.

angles.name: Grant At 67
angles.copy: Happy 67th birthday to the ever-charming Hugh Grant! From rom-coms to dramas, a true British screen favourite.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Pop superstar Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday today.

angles.name: JT At 46
angles.copy: Happy 46th birthday to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake! From boyband to solo sensation, he's still bringing the 'SexyBack'.

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary British actor Sir David Jason celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Del Boy At 87
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the national treasure, Sir David Jason! A true icon of British television. Lovely jubbly!

events.title: 68 years since 'The Day The Music Died'
events.blurb: Today marks 68 years since 'The Day The Music Died', when Buddy Holly (who would have been 91), Ritchie Valens (who would have been 86), and The Big Bopper (who would have been 97) tragically died in a plane crash in 1959.

angles.name: Remembering Music's Lost Stars
angles.copy: 68 years ago, music lost three incredible talents in 'The Day The Music Died'. Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper today.
